note: Between Horizons (I027 Tier 4): Dreams of the Sea - the Captain's lifetime ambitions, a modest journal on the laptop. Read by Dreams (src/core/dreams.gd). All are visible from the start; the Captain chooses which to pursue (up to Dreams.MAX_PURSUED at a time) in any order; each comes true by itself from what really happened (the Captain's Log, the boats owned). Kinds: longest_passage (nm: one passage at least this long), visit_north (lat, count: harbours visited at or north of this latitude), visit_region (regions, count: harbours visited in any of these PortData regions), own_ocean_boat (a yacht fitted for ocean passages, Accommodation), later (a system still to come). I028 adds: arrive, visit_islands, passage, hosted, passenger_dreams, event, publish, renown_rank (see src/core/dreams.gd). No money or renown: they are the Captain's own.

dreams.title: A passage of your own
dreams.text: Sail a real passage: a hundred miles or more in one voyage, from one harbour to the next.

dreams.title: The northern coast
dreams.text: Explore a northern coastline: moor in three harbours north of the sixty-second parallel.

dreams.title: Southern waters
dreams.text: Sail to a distant region: moor in a harbour on the Mediterranean.

dreams.title: The Caribbean
dreams.text: Cross to the Caribbean and moor in one of its harbours.

dreams.title: A boat for the oceans
dreams.text: Own a yacht fitted for ocean passages.

dreams.title: An ocean crossing
dreams.text: Complete a remarkable voyage: a thousand miles or more in one passage.

dreams.title: A book of your travels
dreams.text: Publish a book of your travels - a travelogue, an adventure book or a novel - written from your own voyages.

dreams.title: A known world traveller
dreams.text: Be known among sailors as a true world traveller: reach the top hundred in Sails & Sights.

dreams.title: Sharing the sea
dreams.text: Welcome your first paying passengers aboard and bring them safely to their harbour.

dreams.title: Someone else's dream
dreams.text: Help a passenger fulfil a dream of their own.

dreams.title: Mediterranean island hopping
dreams.text: Hop between islands in the warm south: moor in four Mediterranean island harbours.

dreams.title: Arctic fjords
dreams.text: Sail north of the Arctic Circle and moor in two harbours there.

dreams.title: Across the Atlantic
dreams.text: Cross the Atlantic under sail in one passage, from the old world to the new.

dreams.title: A night under sail with guests
dreams.text: Sail through a night at sea with passengers sleeping aboard.

dreams.title: A welcoming boat
dreams.text: Carry twenty-five passengers over the years.
